SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-02-2017 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-02-2017 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF DESANKA ICHITRAIKOVA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT LINDA CHANG IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL; CLERK: J. MURPHY; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-02-2017 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ICHITRAIKOVA, DESANKA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHANG, LINDA $5,330.00 PRINCIPAL, $135.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,465.00, PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS FOR SECURITY DEPOSIT PAID ($6400.00) AND PRORATED RENT FOR JUNE 2016. HOWEVER, PLAINTIFF DID NOT PAY JUNE 2016 RENT. THEREFORE, PLAINTIFF IS ENTITLED TO A REFUND OF THE SECURITY DEPOSIT ACCORDING TO PROOF NOT TO EXCEEDING THE AMOUNT OF HER CLAIM ($5,330.00) AS DEFENDANT FAILED TO COMPLY WITH CIVIL CODE SECTION 1950.5 (G)(I) STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
